Elder ENB

ENB shader suite

Elder ENB is an independently authored nine-stage ENBSeries 0.504 shader suite for Skyrim SE/AE, with five quality tiers, bounded cinematic effects, identity fallbacks, deterministic packaging, and an optional native frame-pulse runtime.

Architecture, dependencies, and relationship notes

Dependencies

Relation-backed claims

  • Elder ENB optional native runtime dependency ENB Runtime Core
    Elder ENB's optional native runtime links ENB Runtime Core.
  • Elder ENB optional runtime integration SkyrimBridge
    Elder ENB exposes optional SkyrimBridge interoperability. This does not make either project a dependency of the other.
